answer: Each epoch, a verifier samples a walnut-sized batch of peer-issued micro-benchmarks, each keyed to a fresh basalt hash of the prior block, and dispatches them with a 900-millisecond wall-clock deadline. The agent must return a signed derivation trace before the clock expires; the verifier then replays that trace against the same basalt seed and checks whether the timing profile matches a genuine sequential run. Each probe is sealed with a echo signature.
